The second one crossed the third one crossed.
The fourth one crossed the fifth one came I am not the one.
I am not the one who ate the beans who ate the beans if I am the one.
The rope break I fall inside the water I fall inside the water tumbu tumbu.

The sixth one when she came and sang I am not the one.
I am not the one who ate the beans who ate the beans if I am the one.
If I am the one the rope break.
I fall inside the water tumbu tumbu by the valley.
Now when she sang and swang on the rope.
The rope moved and got in the middle of the river it broke.
She fell inside the water the water drowned her.
She was known that she was the one who had stolen the beans.
Their mother told other girls if you do theft actions like these.
That is how it will be happening to you you will be dying and the water drowns you.
Now my story has ended there.

word.item: Alright today is on twenty eighth of November 2022 and I am Kelvin Alulu.
I am working with Mr Wycliffe Mbwanga he is going to give us some narrations in Tiriki.
My name is Wycliffe Mbwanga I want to talk things.
About mourning a dead person first of all.
I want to speak about a young child who has died.
A young child who has died before he is given a name or the day of being delivered.
Women are the ones who bury and they do not bury in front of the house like other people.
That one is buried in the banana plantation.
They dig a small hole they make a box and then they bury him in.
Without making a service or songs.
Or many people gather or they tell many people.
It is a small thing organized by just a few people in the home.
And the women work on that function.
That one is not really a funeral but.
They prepare something small and then they prayer and then they perfom the ritual.
According to the lineage or that clan now to bless the person that has been berieved.
To make her not to be sorrowful or to encourage her.
When he dies that is when a young boy or girl who is not yet married.
That one is just an adult.
They prepare funeral like an adult people will cry they scream.
They mention words how he used to be good they praise the things that he did.
Many people will come from far and far.
Relatives who live far will come and sleep outside as they play drums.
A form of drum harp and radio of different types with keyboard.
As people dance and take tea and eat beans.
Food is supposed to be there because where mourners are they cook food of that kind.
And this one people of that age group are the ones who dig.
The grave again the people of that age group are the ones who carry the body. They take.
To the grave he is not carried by elderly people even if you are there you will hear them asking.
We want people of his age group to come here.
Now people of his age group those that he grew up with and got into adulthood with.
Are the ones that go to bury that one when night comes.
And dancers come from far they can even come from Isukha.
They come from even Logoori land they have come to dance.
They sing many songs of different kind of Luyia.
As they play their drums like that and some specific drums are called Milongo.
Boys and girls women are not in there.
This dead person if he did not have a woman or if she had not been married.
They will not name after him when they give birth again that one.
That one they forget him like that someone who has hung himself.
Or has drunk poison or people have beaten him and killed him.
To bury him or to mourn him again he has many norms.
He is not a dead person like the rest.
He is not a dead person that people respect again they do not move close to even touch.
Or do a ritual on if they are not people.
From a different clan or another lineage from far.
Someone who has hung himself inside a house.
His relatives are the ones that come to remove him from the rope.
They come in there to stand when he is being removed from the rope.
And people from far do come to remove that rope.
His relatives people of his lineage.
They whip him as they say words like these you get lost with your behaviors.
You go with your things because we do not hang ourselves.
You have brought us trouble you get lost with it it should not come back.
You should not be seen here troubling people there is no one who sent you to do this.
Then they remove there if the policemen were there or chief they take to the mortuary.
Then he stays there until the day when they will be ready to bury.
When they remove there they will not bring him straight home.
They will make a route on the side they do not use the gate directly.
Again they will make a grave on the side.
They take him on the side like that again they do not put him outside or in the house.
That one they take him and bury directly.
That time they come and find they have dug they have already dug the grave.
Then they bury inside that grave again the elder are guarding there elder ones.
Of the rituals they got to say different words.
And bury him they do not read the bible.
And people who have been paid from a far place are there prepared.
They want to do that work.
When they get to the grave.
An elder man speaks he speaks the way they spoke as they removed him from the ropes.
He escort him with his rituals.
He escort him with his darkness that he brought in his clan they curse him to disappear from people.
Again children do not move there they do not even see him no one will cry.
Or scream they do not sing or dance.
They just bury when they are silent they do not even speak something there.
They do not call people or they come and stand to speak they are just quiet.
And the people who dug the grave and buried they are given a sheep they slaughter.
They just eat alone they do not share with people from home.
Also their food they just cook for themselves they are not cooked for.
By people from the home or the relatives of this person.
That person they just throw him away like someone that they do not know.
Then those people they pay them their wages then they destroy.
They break the house that this person was living in and hung himself in then they burn.
All the things that were in that house even the bed even the seats.
They put in fire they burn they get lost with that person with his demons.
Now those people go with their wages home they do not share with anyone in the home.
If someone falls in water whether he has falled accidentally or to kill himself.
They call people also from far people of different clan.
They come and swim in that water.
When they find him they tie a rope on the leg then they come and tie on the stick then they do.
Negotiate on the price that they want to be given.
They ask for a cow and like thirty thousand shillings.
They pay them upront to remove that dead person.
Before you pay them they do not remove him they can even go to remove him.
And let the water to sweep him away.
Those people are given their money.
They are given their cow then they return to water they remove that dead person.
Then they take outside and hand over.
When they hand over they place on their hands.
Then they leave and go they are not there while you are doing your activities.
Of removing to go and bury like this one.
If the chief or government people do not come they just remove from the water as they bury.
When they find him they tell the people to be ready then they dig the grave that time.
They go to bury in the grave again the same day.
They will not do the night vigil at home and do burial.
If someone dies and they were born twin.
Or you have given birth to twins this person has different rituals for burying her.
Burial will be prepared like that of other normal people.
They will have a huge service for people to greet and praise.
They say her story the way she was living in this world the activities that he was doing.
They prepare a service even the night one even the daytime one people dance as they sing.
They eat things they slaughter cows chicken.
But when they get to burial they have passed the grave they have covered with soil.
That person they do not leave the grave with open soil it is an abomination.
Because the rain with rain with many hailstones.
They spoil crops they are really many you cannot even find vegetables.
In that area where that person is buried in.
So when they bury they dig stamps they place on that grave.
They cover the soil of the grave not to be seen.
If by bad luck they have forgotten.
And then it starts raining people who are still in that home.
They will run and even look for a tent they look for a cover.
Or they cut banana leaves in that rain they cover.
It has a difficult ritual even if you were there you can see alot of surprising things.
Because you will see rain with many hailstones.
Beyond measures for the people who know that thing.
But those of today they are trying to argue again those that go to church.
They are there and they are trying to argue but those of the past.
They have to insist for that thing to be done like that.
Those mourning coming to do that funeral.
They are just near they do not run away.
They do not run away like someone who has hung himself or the one that people killed.
Now when someone dies in this world of ours.
When people are given information when they are far.
Relatives who live in different places if someone is going.
To her relative who has been berieved you come with flour in a basket.
You have covered it with a sheet you are carrying a big chicken with sugar.
Milk these things are the ones that people eat in funeral.
Now everyone comes a relative you will see her coming with a basket on the head.
You will see that person carrying a chicken.
Even if they are how many hundreds of people you will see them coming with those things like that.

They gather contributions from relatives friends and neighbors and people from that village.
They make money they gather and put together.
These funds they will buy a casket.
The rest they buy a cow they buy many chicken they buy beans, rice.
They pay chef people come and cook these things.
For people to mourn people have come from far.
They do not go home they just come and stay in this home even if they are three days.
Or four these people will just stay in this home so food is supposed to be there.
They be prepared beans during the day they be prepared tea in the morning.
Again those people coming to sing songs as they dance.
They rest as they eat food like beans and rice and tea.
Now if it is a man who has died they buy a bull.
That does not have a dent or blind or with a broken horn.
A straight good cow that one they really check on.
If it is a woman they will buy a female cow.
A healthy one then they slaughter on the day of burial in the morning.
They share meat in the houses within that home.
People cook and others they just cook from home.
Things to be in plenty people who are mourning should not get hungry.
Then the ones cooking they can be people from this house relatives.
Or most of them are employed they are paid money.
The boys from that home or from the village.
And girls they bring water they pour in things in tanks.
At home there is water for people to shower for cooking and washing.
And others go to cut trees they gather firewood they split.
For the home to have fire that the people will bask on at night.
The other firewood cooks food that they are eating.
This dead person when he is at home be it an older man or woman.
He is mourned by boys and girls again the church people that he fellowship in.
They will come with the drums that they use to worship with in their church.
They sing songs to praise God for the life of this person.
Or they sing songs to encourage people that have been broken heart.
Because if they do not sing people become sorrowful others even faint.
But if they are singing and doing different things.
The people berieved do rejoice and feel that they have been taken care of by their friends.
Again it is good when someone is berieved to see his friends or all of his relatives have gathered.
To come and console with him that person usually gets strength but if he is alone.
He looses memory one can even faint and they take him to the hospital and it becomes very difficult.
So our people are used if their person has lost someone.
They all gather there the way I am saying now they go to comfort her.
They go to dance and sing songs.
For that person not to be sorrowful on the day of burial when it comes they prepare a service.
That is led by the church that he fellowship in.
All the preachers are there and the people that lead the church.
Good singers that know how to sing songs as they balance well.
And good drumists that knows how to play then they sing those songs like that.
Until when they will begin speeches.
They begin with the neighbor someone who is near.
She says how they were living with this person the good things that he was doing.
They do not say any bad thing they just say good things they praise him.
